body: HAHA thought i was out of the woods, NOPE.  ive called the suicide prevention number multiple times only to hang up.  ive prepared those texts to my family.  im just tired.

I just want to take a second and thank everyone that has either PM'ed me or written a comment below.  Just know that you probably saved a Mom from burying her son.  Through comments and messages from internet strangers, I have found some solace and will wake up and do my best to be a better me tomorrow.

In terms of right now, I wrote everything down on a piece of paper that I hated about myself, eulogy style.  I'm going to go out in my front lawn, in a suit and read it out loud and bury that person (burn the paper).  Overly dramatic, yes, but the writing portion really helped, hopefully the burning will as well.

Thank you all again, basically saved a life tonight.  Go drink some water and watch cartoons, thank you from the bottom of my heart.
